notes.title: Let's Play Ctrl+Alt+Destroy | Dev Stream
notes.content:
Join us as we stream our new Ctrl+Alt+Destroy demo! Watch a few Meister teammates engage in some friendly competition. 

Watch us play Blackout, Capture the Plug, Brawler, and Cyber Blitz on 2 maps found in the demo! 

Download the demo yourself and play with your friends locally! Or jump into an online session using the new online Alpha! 

Thank you for tuning in! 
[url=www.meister.tv]Meister[/url]
